caption: The drawing features a single ceramic vessel resembling a teapot or jug, centrally placed against a plain, light-colored background. The vessel has a rounded body with a wide base, a short spout angled from the upper left side, a large curved handle on the top, and a smaller, nubby handle or protrusion opposite the spout. The surface of the vessel shows shades of brown, tan, and hints of reddish hues, rendered with visible brushstrokes that give a sense of texture and glazing on the ceramic. Highlights and shadows indicate a light source from the upper left, further defining the rounded shape of the object. The background remains empty, drawing full attention to the vessel.
title: Pa. German Cider Jug
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
